policy: Conservative map eligibility: require explicit museum-description evidence of Owney visiting or receiving the tag in one named city. Exclude donor hometowns/workplaces alone, manufacturer or advertising associations, general visits not tied to the dated record, railway services or on-board exchanges without a stop, multiple/unresolved places, and dateCaution conflicts. Keep all67 dated tags in the cube. Dates remain recorded tag dates; map coordinates are editorial city-center geocoding, not Smithsonian-provided coordinates. Ellipses separate short exact excerpts from a single museum description.
